result.topic_en: Euler sets up the equilibrium of horizontal forces and of moments about point A for the column, solving for the end forces A and B, and then begins considering the moments about a general point Y equated to the elastic moment Ekk/r.

items.quote: ſumma omnium horum momentorum per totam altitudinem erit $\frac{1}{2}Cb$
items.english: the sum of all these moments over the whole height will be ½Cb

items.quote: Nunc iam totam columnam, quaſi in puncto Y eſſet fixa, contemplemur, atque ex omnibus viribus, arcum AY ſollicitantibus, earum momenta inueſtigemus reſpectu huius puncti Y
items.english: Now let us consider the whole column as if it were fixed at the point Y, and from all the forces acting on the arc AY let us investigate their moments with respect to this point Y

items.quote: quippe quorum ſumma aequalis eſſe debet momento elaſticitatis
items.english: the sum of these moments must equal the moment of elasticity
